'''Kryos''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Overseer (Sith)|Sith Overseer]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] on the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He [[Sith training|trained]] a [[Darth Nox|new]] [[Sith Inquisitor]] who was sent by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Krillis]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kryos appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as the Advanced Class trainer for the Sith Inquisitor class, wherein players were sent to him by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Krillis]] to learn the skills of either a [[Sith sorcerer|Sith Sorcerer]] or a [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith Assassin]]. He was removed in Game Update 5.0, when advanced classes were made available on character creation rather than level 10.<ref name="TOR" />
